notes.title: Whimsical Heroes now available in Early Access
notes.notes:
[p]Hidden Capybaras with Oranges aren’t the only adorable creatures created by Whimsical Universes. We are excited to announce that our new game Whimsical Heroes is now available for purchase on Steam in Early Access![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683750/Whimsical_Heroes/" style="button"]Whimsical Heroes[/url]
[/p][p]If you’re a fan of our charming Capybaras, you’ll surely enjoy meeting the inhabitants of Whimsicalia, the land where Whimsical Heroes takes place. A grumpy fluffy cat, an onion bard, and a bean-shaped traveler may not have any oranges, but they’re just as colorful and lovable as the stars of our capybara series.[/p][p][/p][p]Whimsical Heroes is a tactical turn-based game where you lead a team of cartoonish characters into battle for magical Bubbles. With its cozy art style and easy-to-learn combat system, the game is perfect for anyone looking for a cozy experience, while still offering enough challenge for more seasoned players.[/p][p][/p][p]Still not sure? Try the free demo:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465340/Whimsical_Heroes_Demo/" style="button"]Whimsical Heroes Demo[/url]
[/p][p]Play Whimsical Heroes today and share your feedback with us so we can continue to improve and expand the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45250443/350c944b5e74df01c35debec8a0a47ef4ce3a193.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey, capybara seekers!

In this update, we've fixed a rare bug reported by one of the players and improved the quality of effects.

Full changelog:

- Fixed a very rare bug that caused unintended camera movement without player input.
- Increased the quality of visual effects when clicking on a capybara and upon finding all capybaras.
- Optimized some graphics, which should slightly reduce the game's disk size.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, capybara seekers![/h2]

We are happy to announce that [b]Hidden Capybaras with Orange: Spooky Halloween Edition[/b] can proudly sport the [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b] badge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45250443/2c57cf2294b0b92efeef50892456e147208cbdae.png[/img]

We’ve also updated the game to include camera control using the keyboard and improved controls on the Steam Deck. Additionally, we’ve added a recommended default configuration on Steam Deck.

Here’s the full list of changes:

[list]
[*] Added camera control using the WSAD or arrow keys
[*] Added Default Controller Configuration for Steam Deck
[*] Improved cursor behavior on Steam Deck
[*] Updated some graphics in the main menu
[/list]

We hope you’re enjoying our game. We look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Hidden Capybaras with Orange and Pumpkins: Spooky Halloween Edition is here!
notes.notes:
Are you ready for the most capybara-filled Halloween ever?

[b]Hidden Capybaras with Orange and Pumpkins: Spooky Halloween Edition[/b] are now available!

Hidden Capybaras with Orange and Pumpkins: Spooky Halloween Edition is a cozy, relaxing hidden-object game featuring capybaras in a charming Halloween setting. The game is completely [b]FREE [/b]and includes a nighttime level with 100 hidden capybaras, 5 cats, and a few special characters. Discover atmospheric lighting that illuminates with each capybara you find. Some of these charming creatures appear in Halloween costumes. Trick or treat?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45250443/5bc839c0e1c087f46fc1c273996dcff60b6f063b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45250443/4fd966dad98f80581c66d22f35b00b08aed94286.png[/img][/url]

We’re looking forward to your reviews and feedback!
